common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
common.downloadFailed: The download could not be started.
common.noAccess: You do not have access to this screen.

problem.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
twoFactor.codeHint: The 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Each recovery code works only once.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.

setup.title: Welcome to IntraWatch
setup.intro: Create the owner account. It can manage everything in this instance.
setup.workspaceHint: For example your company or team name. You can rename it later.
setup.timezoneHint: Used for dates, maintenance windows and reports.
setup.done: Setup complete. You are signed in.

relogin.title: Your session has expired
relogin.intro: Sign in again to continue. Your unsaved changes stay on the page and are sent once you are back.

confirmPassword.title: Confirm your password
confirmPassword.intro: This is a sensitive action. Enter your password to continue.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.enabledText: Signing in requires a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.disabledText: Protect your account with a time-based code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for setting up the authenticator app
twoFactor.secret: Cannot scan it? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in once without your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.regenerateConfirm: Your current recovery codes stop working and new ones are shown once.
twoFactor.disableConfirm: Signing in will only need your password. You can turn it on again at any time.

empty.title: No workspace yet
empty.text: You are not a member of any workspace. Create one, or ask an owner to invite you.

placeholder.title: Coming soon
placeholder.text: This screen is not available yet.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.name: Name
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

danger.title: Delete workspace
danger.text: Deleting the workspace permanently removes its monitors, channels, status pages and history.
danger.confirmText: Type the workspace name {name} to confirm.

add.title: Add a member
add.hint: The person must already have an account on this instance.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: A token lets a script or integration call the API as you, limited to this workspace and the abilities you pick.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.empty: You have no tokens in this workspace.

plain.title: Your new token
plain.warning: Copy it now. It is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.

monitors.title: Monitors
monitors.loadError: The monitors could not be loaded.

summary.label: Status of loaded monitors
summary.note: Counts cover the loaded monitors only.

bulk.label: Bulk actions
bulk.limit: At most {max} monitors can be changed at once. Deselect {extra} to continue.
bulk.deleteConfirm: Delete {count} monitors with their history? This cannot be undone.

monitorEditor.readOnly: You can view this monitor but not change it.
monitorEditor.noChanges: Nothing to save, no fields were changed.

leave.title: Discard changes?
leave.text: You have unsaved changes. If you leave this page they are lost.

common.typeLocked: The type cannot be changed after the monitor is created.
common.name: Name
common.activeHint: A paused monitor is not checked and does not alert.
common.invertedHint: Treat a failing check as up and a passing check as down.
common.intervalMin: The interval must be at least {min} seconds for this type.
common.timeoutHint: At most 80% of the check interval.
common.retriesHint: Failed checks repeated before the monitor is marked down.
common.degradedThresholdHint: Mark the monitor degraded when a check takes longer than this. Leave empty to disable.

alerting.resendHint: Repeat the alert while the monitor stays down. 0 sends no reminders.
alerting.degradedAfterHint: How long the monitor must stay degraded before an alert is sent.

notifications.label: Notification channels
notifications.hint: Channels that receive this monitor's alerts.

ping.countHint: 1 to 5. The timeout must be longer than the packet count minus one second.

dns.name: Name to resolve
dns.resolverHint: Optional IP address with an optional port. Empty uses the system resolver.
dns.expectedHint: Press Enter after each value. Leave empty to only require an answer.

tls.expiryDaysHint: Press Enter after each number of days.

domain.domainHint: The registered domain, for example example.com.
domain.expiryDaysHint: Press Enter after each number of days.

push.info: After you save, the push URL appears on the monitor's detail page. Call it from your job or service at least once per interval to report it as up.
push.graceHint: How long to wait past the expected heartbeat before marking the monitor down.

cron.info: After you save, the push URL appears on the monitor's detail page. Call it when your scheduled job finishes (or starts and finishes) to report it.
cron.timezoneHint: Empty uses the workspace time zone.
cron.graceHint: How long to wait past the scheduled time before marking the job missed.
cron.maxRuntimeHint: Optional. Mark the job failed when it runs longer than this.

modeHints.all: The group is down as soon as one member is down.
modeHints.any: The group is down only when every member is down.
modeHints.quorum: The group is down when fewer than the required number of members are up.

group.quorumHint: Minimum number of members that must be up.

http.acceptedStatusHint: Press Enter after each code or range, for example 200-299 or 301.
http.headersHint: Credentials such as Authorization belong in the secret headers below.
http.secretHeadersHint: One per line as Name: value. Values are never shown again; entering new ones replaces all of them.
http.keywordEnable: Check the response body for a keyword
http.jsonEnable: Check a value in a JSON response
http.tlsExpiryDaysHint: Press Enter after each number of days.
http.pemHint: Paste the PEM text. It is never shown again.
http.secretHeadersInvalid: Lines {lines} are not in the Name: value format.
